bluf: Crowd-heavy Sunday with dangerous heat and active storm threat. Monster Jam matinee draws 10,000+ to Moody Center (1 PM, UT corridor) — morning valet/routing impact. NCAA Super Regionals Game 2 (Texas vs. Oregon, 9 PM ESPN, must-win for Oregon) fills Disch-Falk to 8,500+ with late-night dispersal pushing past midnight. Heat index at 103°F — enforce outdoor guest advisories and brief staff on heat protocols. NWS severe thunderstorm watch active; isolated large hail, damaging winds, and tornado possible through evening — outdoor event cancellation/delay risk for Game 2. Karmelo Anthony prosecution rested Saturday after 21 witnesses; defense opens Monday 9 AM — trial now entering most critical phase. Protest watch remains active. FIFA WC threat window: 4 days to tournament kickoff (June 11).

incidents.title: NCAA Baseball Super Regionals Game 2 — Texas vs. Oregon (Elimination Game)
incidents.location: UFCU Disch-Falk Field, 1 Nolte Dr (1.8 mi E of property)
incidents.detail: Texas leads series 1-0 after dominant 11-3 win Saturday night (attendance 8,550 — over capacity). Adrian Rodriguez drove in 5 RBI. Game 2 tonight, 9 PM CT, ESPN. Must-win for Oregon — if Texas wins, series over; if Oregon wins, Game 3 Monday TBD. Late 9 PM start means post-game dispersal will extend past midnight (11:30 PM–1 AM depending on game length). I-35/Red River/6th Street corridor congestion expected from approximately 7 PM through 1 AM. Longhorn nation high-energy — elevated bar and entertainment district activity throughout evening. Brief valet and overnight shift on extended late crowd dispersal.

incidents.detail: Sunday matinee Monster Jam: Parking 10 AM, Pit Party 11 AM, Doors noon, Show 1 PM. Family crowd 10,000+. incidents.title: Severe Thunderstorm/Tornado Risk — Travis County
incidents.detail: NWS Austin Area Forecast Discussion confirms active severe weather pattern through weekend. Severe thunderstorms capable of large hail, damaging winds (60+ mph gusts), and isolated tornadoes possible over central Texas through Sunday evening. Heat index at 103°F by afternoon with South wind gusts to 20 mph. Thunderstorms with heavy to excessive rainfall moving from Texas into mid-Mississippi Valley — flash flooding threat elevated given already-saturated ground from Friday night's event. Primary impact window: late afternoon through evening (4–10 PM). NCAA Game 2 (9 PM start) could be delayed or suspended. Coordinate with engineering on outdoor furniture securing protocol.

incidents.title: Toledo Festival Shooting — Soft-Target Pattern Advisory
incidents.location: Toledo OH Old West End Festival (national awareness item)
incidents.detail: Multiple people shot Saturday evening near Toledo's Old West End Festival. Large outdoor public festival attack pattern consistent with elevated pre-World Cup soft-target environment. No Austin nexus; reinforces posture for outdoor event crowd awareness at MACC (Day 2), Super Regionals, and any property terrace gatherings. Suspects at large as of filing. Pattern alert: outdoor festivals remain highest-risk venue category nationally.

civil_unrest.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Prosecution Rests; Defense Opens Monday
civil_unrest.location: Collin County Courthouse, McKinney TX (~200 mi NE) / Austin monitor
civil_unrest.detail: Saturday was a rare full-session court day (nearly 9 hours). Prosecution rested after 21 witnesses — many teenagers who became emotional on the stand. Key Saturday testimony: Medical examiner Dr. Elizabeth Ventura testified Metcalf was stabbed through the heart (2.5-inch gaping wound, 'not survivable'). One witness testified Metcalf asked Anthony to leave the tent approximately 15 times before stabbing. Defense opens Monday 9 AM — self-defense argument and Frisco ISD 'no policy barring athletes from other teams tents' angle. Anthony faces 5–99 years or life if convicted. Social media polarization extremely high; verdict-reactive demonstration planning active online. Monitor Capitol/Congress Ave corridor and social media through verdict.

property_actions: HEAT PROTOCOL — Heat index 103°F today. Mandate water/shade rotation for all outdoor staff (valet, door, pool, terrace). Have cold water available at valet stand. Watch for guest distress — pool and terrace areas are highest risk.
STORM MONITORING — Assign one staff member per shift to monitor NWS Austin radar from 3 PM. Know storm shelter locations. Secure outdoor furniture on terrace and pool deck if storm warning issued.

VALET — Surge windows: 10 AM–Noon (Monster Jam pre-event), 3:30–5 PM (Monster Jam dispersal + early Super Regionals arrivals), 7:30–9 PM (Game 2 pre-event), 11 PM–1 AM (Game 2 post + bar close). Pre-position overnight staff for late dispersal.

LATE-NIGHT PROTOCOL — Game 2 post-game dispersal expected 11:30 PM–1:00 AM. Brief overnight front desk and security on elevated pedestrian traffic on San Jacinto Blvd approach from east. Firm lobby access protocol.

GUEST ROUTING — Advise guests: avoid I-35/Red River corridor 7–9 PM and UT/Guadalupe 10 AM–4 PM. Disch-Falk post-game: avoid Red River northbound 11 PM–1 AM. Recommend Cesar Chavez or Congress Ave routing.

CYBER HYGIENE — FIFA WC advisory window: 4 days to June 11 tournament kickoff. Elevate staff awareness on phishing/QR code fraud to F&B, concierge, and front desk teams. Report any anomalous POS behavior immediately.
national_context: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Tournament kickoff June 11 in Los Angeles, New York/New Jersey, and Dallas. T-4 days. FBI/DHS soft-target and cyber advisory window intensifying. Host-city and adjacent hospitality properties on elevated posture. Austin not a host city but elevated threat applies broadly to luxury hospitality.

Toledo OH Festival Shooting (June 6) — Multiple victims at outdoor festival, suspects at large. Reinforces soft-target threat pattern at public gatherings nationally. Cross-reference: MACC, Super Regionals, Monster Jam all fall within this profile.

Karmelo Anthony Trial — Prosecution rested Saturday (21 witnesses, 3+ days of testimony). Defense opens Monday. Trial entering critical phase — social media monitoring for Austin-area protest mobilization warranted through verdict.

Iran/US Geopolitical Tension — Euronews reports Iran-US exchanges and fragile ceasefire condition as of June 6 evening. No direct domestic impact; global instability backdrop contributes to elevated cyber threat environment per FinCEN FIN-2026-A002 advisory.
lookaheads: MONDAY JUNE 8 — Karmelo Anthony trial resumes 9 AM, defense opens. Heat index 105°F — most dangerous heat day of the stretch. NCAA Super Regionals Game 3 possible (TBD time if Oregon wins tonight). Monitor verdict-reactive protest mobilization.

TUESDAY–WEDNESDAY — FIFA WC threat window at peak intensity as June 11 tournament open approaches. Maintain elevated cyber and physical posture. Austin-area venues should expect elevated threat environment through at least June 14.
WEATHER TREND — Oppressive heat continues through early week (105°F heat index Monday). Thunderstorm pattern persists — flash flood watch possible again if additional heavy rainfall.

NCAA SUPER REGIONALS — If Texas wins Game 2 tonight, they advance to Men's College World Series (Omaha, June 14). Major celebration activity in Austin Monday morning — monitor 6th Street and UT campus.
